# Elements of vec{F} realizing K and its reverse

K = the oriented knot of KnotInfo, Kr = its reverse, Km = its mirror image, Kmr = the mirror image of the reverse (for an amphicheiral knot some of them coincide, written e.g. K = Kmr). Orientation of L(g) from the 2-colouring of the Tait graph (colour + = counterclockwise); reversing this convention exchanges K with Kr and Km with Kmr. All the elements are in results/reverse_examples.csv; here at most 3 per orientation.
